title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 03 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 02 March 2026 Mainly dry weather will prevail in the most parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern, North-western and North-central provinces and in Vavuniya district during the early hours of the morning.
